data.label: SOC 2 Type II & ISO 27001 Certification Roadmap
data.description: End-to-end compliance, security engineering, and external audit roadmap to achieve SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 readiness. Covers scope definition, ISMS policies, cloud hardening, vendor risk, penetration testing, and automated evidence collection. Duration: 20.11.2026 – 31.12.2026 (6 weeks / 30 working days).

dna.problem: Enterprise sales deals blocked due to lack of formal SOC 2 Type II report, ISO 27001 certification, and verified continuous security posture.
dna.solution: Deploy continuous compliance automation (Drata/Vanta), formalize corporate ISMS, harden cloud infrastructure, and pass external CPA firm audit with zero exceptions.
dna.targetAudience: Enterprise B2B clients, procurement teams, enterprise CISOs, and security review committees.
dna.marketLandscape: Strict enterprise procurement landscape requiring verified SOC 2 Type II attestations, GDPR compliance, and independent penetration test reports.
dna.businessModel: Unlocks enterprise annual contracts ($50k - $250k+ ACV) and eliminates procurement cycle friction.
dna.gtmStrategy: Public Security Trust Center, automated NDA click-through report sharing, and continuous compliance posture badges.

data.subtitle: Trust Services Criteria, data flow & gap analysis (20.11 – 27.11.2026)

panelData.notes: Scoping phase defining exact cloud boundaries, in-scope services, and baseline remediation backlog.

cards.title: Define SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria and ISO 27001 Statement of Applicability (SoA)
cards.description: Select applicable security controls and document justifications for any excluded clauses.

checklist.label: Select Security, Availability, and Confidentiality TSC
Document Annex A controls justification in SoA

cards.title: Map production system architecture and data-flow boundaries
cards.description: Create up-to-date network, cloud, and customer data flow diagrams for the auditor.

cards.title: Deploy compliance automation platform (Vanta / Drata) and connect integrations
cards.description: Link AWS/GCP, GitHub, Okta, and HRIS systems for continuous control monitoring.

cards.title: Conduct comprehensive gap analysis against baseline controls
cards.description: Catalog all failing technical and procedural checks and assign remediation owners.

cards.title: Select accredited CPA / ISO audit firm and lock observation window
cards.description: Finalize engagement letter, audit calendar, and evidence delivery milestones.

data.label: Information Security Policies & Governance
data.subtitle: ISMS documentation, risk register & committee (24.11 – 04.12.2026)
data.description: Establish the Information Security Management System (ISMS), formalize corporate policies, and institute recurring risk reviews. (24.11.2026 – 04.12.2026)

panelData.notes: Formal policy framework approved by executive leadership and reviewed annually.

cards.title: Draft and ratify core Information Security and Access Control policies
cards.description: Formalize password standards, least-privilege rules, and MFA mandates across all systems.

cards.title: Publish Acceptable Use, Data Classification, and Retention policies
cards.description: Define handling rules for confidential customer data, PII, and automated purge schedules.

cards.title: Formalize Change Management and Secure SDLC policy
cards.description: Document mandatory PR peer reviews, CI/CD checks, and production deployment approvals.

cards.title: Conduct formal annual Risk Assessment and build Risk Register
cards.description: Score technical, operational, and third-party threats with documented mitigation plans.

cards.title: Establish quarterly Security Committee charter and meeting minutes
cards.description: Hold initial leadership governance review to approve ISMS objectives and sign off policies.

data.label: Cloud Infrastructure & Access Hardening
data.subtitle: MFA, MDM, encryption, audit logs & UAR (25.11 – 11.12.2026)
data.description: Remediate technical infrastructure gaps across cloud environments, identity providers, endpoints, and source code repositories. (25.11.2026 – 11.12.2026)

panelData.notes: Technical remediation ensuring 100% green tests in continuous monitoring automation.

cards.title: Enforce hardware-backed MFA and SSO across all production and SaaS tools
cards.description: Eliminate standalone passwords and enforce Okta/Google Workspace SSO with SAML 2.0.

cards.title: Configure full-disk encryption and MDM enrollment on all employee laptops
cards.description: Deploy Kandji/Jamf/Intune to enforce FileVault/BitLocker, screen locks, and OS auto-updates.

cards.title: Enable encryption at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3) across all data stores
cards.description: Audit S3 buckets, RDS databases, and load balancers to remove public access and legacy ciphers.

cards.title: Lock down GitHub branch protection and mandatory code review rules
cards.description: Require signed commits, passing status checks, and at least one approving review on main branches.

cards.title: Centralize immutable audit logs and configure SIEM anomaly alerts
cards.description: Route CloudTrail, Kubernetes, and auth logs to a tamper-proof archive with 365-day retention.

cards.title: Execute quarterly User Access Review (UAR) across production systems
cards.description: Audit all active admin privileges, revoke stale accounts, and archive signed approval logs.

data.label: HR Security, Onboarding & Vendor Risk Management
data.subtitle: Background checks, security training & vendor DPAs (03.12 – 18.12.2026)
data.description: Ensure personnel compliance, security awareness training, and rigorous due diligence for all critical sub-processors. (03.12.2026 – 18.12.2026)

panelData.notes: People and supply chain security controls, training verification, and third-party risk management.

cards.title: Verify background checks and signed NDAs for 100% of employees and contractors
cards.description: Audit HR folders to close any missing employment agreements or confidentiality clauses.

cards.title: Roll out mandatory annual Security Awareness and Phishing training
cards.description: Track 100% completion certificates and policy acknowledgments across the organization.

cards.title: Standardize employee onboarding and 24-hour offboarding checklists
cards.description: Automate ticket workflows ensuring immediate access revocation upon role change or termination.

cards.title: Build Vendor Inventory and classify sub-processors by data risk tier
cards.description: Catalog every SaaS and infrastructure vendor accessing customer or corporate data.

cards.title: Collect SOC 2 reports, DPAs, and security questionnaires from Tier-1 vendors
cards.description: Review third-party audit exceptions and document formal vendor risk acceptance.

data.label: Vulnerability Management, Pen-Testing & Incident Response
data.subtitle: SAST/DAST, third-party pen-test & BCDR drill (07.12 – 23.12.2026)
data.description: Validate defensive resilience through third-party penetration testing, continuous scanning, and live disaster recovery drills. (07.12.2026 – 23.12.2026)

panelData.notes: Empirical verification of security controls through external offensive testing and disaster recovery simulations.

cards.title: Configure automated SAST, DAST, and container vulnerability scanning in CI/CD
cards.description: Integrate Dependabot/Snyk and enforce SLA remediation windows (Critical < 72h, High < 14d).

cards.title: Commission third-party black-box and grey-box penetration test
cards.description: Engage CREST-certified testers to evaluate web app, APIs, and cloud perimeter.

cards.title: Remediate pen-test findings and obtain clean re-test attestation letter
cards.description: Patch all Critical and High findings and archive official executive summary report.

cards.title: Run tabletop Incident Response (IR) breach simulation drill
cards.description: Simulate credential compromise, verify escalation paths, and document lessons learned.

cards.title: Execute Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery (BCDR) backup restore test
cards.description: Restore production database snapshot into isolated staging and record actual RTO/RPO metrics.

data.label: Automated Evidence Collection & External Audit Execution
data.subtitle: Mock audit, PBC sampling, interviews & Trust Center (16.12 – 31.12.2026)
data.description: Complete internal pre-audit review, support external auditor sampling, and publish the final certification trust center. (16.12.2026 – 31.12.2026)

panelData.notes: Official CPA audit observation window, sampling verification, report issuance, and public Trust Center rollout.

cards.title: Perform internal mock audit and verify 100% passing automated tests
cards.description: Resolve all red flags in Vanta/Drata and verify timestamped manual evidence uploads.

cards.title: Fulfill auditor PBC (Prepared by Client) evidence and population sample requests
cards.description: Deliver sampled PR logs, onboarding tickets, access reviews, and change approvals.

cards.title: Conduct external auditor walkthrough interviews with Engineering and HR leads
cards.description: Demonstrate live production controls, monitoring dashboards, and incident playbooks.

cards.title: Review draft SOC 2 Type II / ISO 27001 report and issue Management Assertion letter
cards.description: Verify accuracy of system description, resolve any minor auditor comments, and sign off.

cards.title: Launch public Security Trust Center and publish compliance badges
cards.description: Gate full audit report behind automated NDA workflow for enterprise sales prospects.
